understand.concept: Error ꯑꯁꯤ Code ꯅꯥ ꯑꯁꯥꯕꯥ ꯃꯇꯨꯡ ꯑꯣꯏꯗꯕꯥ ꯍꯥꯌꯕꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯅꯤ। Syntax Error ꯑꯁꯤ Language ꯒꯤ ꯂꯤꯕꯥ Rule ꯈꯣꯡꯗꯕꯗꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯛꯏ। Runtime Error ꯑꯁꯤ Program ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯧꯔꯤꯕꯥ ꯃꯇꯃꯗꯥ ꯊꯣꯛꯏ। Logic Error ꯗꯥ Program ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯧꯏ ꯑꯗꯨꯕꯨ Result ꯑꯔꯥꯅꯕꯥ ꯑꯣꯏ।

examples.code:
1. Reproduce the problem.
2. Read the first useful error.
3. Note file and line.
4. Inspect relevant code.
5. Change one thing and test.
6. Save a working version.

practise.guidedTask: Practice Project amada khudong chadaba oina ama small error create tou. Mathangda kari Input piba matamda kari Expected Result phangjagadage haiba irou. Aduga Input amasung Steps sijinnaduna problem adu amuk reproduce tou amasung Actual Result record tou. Console-gi Error Text, File Name amasung Line Number note tou. Possible cause ama khanba, focused change ama tou, aduga same Test amuk run tou amasung result compare tou.
practise.independentTask: Bug Report ama semjou: Expected Result, Actual Result, reproduce touba Steps, exact Error Message, relevant Code, test touba possible cause, toukhiba change amasung Retest Result. Help pangba mamangda Password, Token amasung personal information remove tou. Backup nattraga Version Control sijinnaduna working version amuk phangba matam adubu irou.
hints: Same Input amasung Steps sijinnaduna problem adu amuk reproduce tou.
Expected amasung Actual Result separate oina irou.
Error Message-da File amasung Line leirabadi note tou.
Hypothesis ama test touba matamda change ama khaktang tou.
Retest Result record tou amasung working Version save tou.

questions.prompt: Program adu run toui, adubu wrong result piri. Madudi kari Error oigani?
questions.explanation: Logic Error-da Program run touba matungda mahakki Logic-na wrong result piri.

questions.prompt: Debugging-gi maru oiba reliable method adu kari?
options: Change ama tou amasung amuk Test tou
questions.answer: Change ama tou amasung amuk Test tou
questions.explanation: Change ama ama test touba matamda karamba change-na result adu hangdok-i haiba khangba ngammi.
